extracted.name: Oat Flour
extracted.description: Learn how to make oat flour at home! Then, use it in muffins, cookies, scones, crumbles, and more.
instruction_lines: Place the oats in a food processor. Blend until the oats become a fine flour, stopping to stir occasionally.
Use in any recipe that calls for oat flour. Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.
